NFP preview: why a payroll beat needs help from unemployment
Why it matters: Rates: A strong combination could lift the expected Fed path and Treasury yields; weak hiring could lower that path. Firmer wages would complicate an easing interpretation, so pay remains a policy cross-check.
Context: The strong branch gains credibility if payrolls and unemployment reinforce each other and rates and the dollar follow the firmer-policy interpretation. The weak branch needs employment weakness and a softer expected policy path. A reversal after revisions or wages are examined would challenge either reading; disagreement across markets would weaken a simple headline explanation.
